title: What Servicing a Resort Lodging Unit Costs on Departure
content:
What the servicing of a Resort Lodging unit costs on departure turns on what the unit has to be put right from: whether the reservation records a dog, and how long the folio shows the party occupied the unit, read against the unit type's length-of-stay threshold in nights.

Where the reservation records one or more dogs and the folio shows the party occupied at least the unit type's length-of-stay threshold in nights, the deep clean share of the unit type's housekeeping charge is taken, being 1.5 times that charge.

Where the reservation records one or more dogs, or the folio shows the party occupied at least that threshold in nights, but not both, the extended clean share of that charge is taken, being 1.25 times it.

Where neither holds, the unit type's housekeeping charge is taken as it stands.

## The threshold in nights, by unit type

| Unit type | Length-of-stay threshold (nights) |
| --- | --- |
| Base Village Inn Room | 5 |
| Slopeside Studio | 5 |
| Slopeside One-Bedroom Residence | 7 |
| Slopeside Two-Bedroom Residence | 7 |
| Mountain Lodge Suite | 7 |
| Summit Penthouse Residence | 7 |
| Private Mountain Chalet | 10 |

| Dogs recorded on the reservation | Nights occupied reaching the threshold | Servicing taken |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | 1.5 times the unit type's housekeeping charge |
| yes | no | 1.25 times it |
| no | yes | 1.25 times it |
| no | no | the housekeeping charge as it stands |

### Three hypothetical departures from a Slopeside One-Bedroom Residence

The unit type's threshold is 7 nights and its housekeeping charge is taken here as 135.00 USD.

A reservation recording 1 dog on a folio showing 7 nights occupied meets both, the 7 nights reaching the threshold, so 202.50 USD is taken, being 1.5 times 135.00 USD.

A reservation recording 1 dog on a folio showing 4 nights occupied meets one of the two, so 168.75 USD is taken, being 1.25 times 135.00 USD. A reservation recording no dog on a folio showing 9 nights occupied likewise meets one of the two and is taken at the same share.

A reservation recording no dog on a folio showing 4 nights occupied meets neither, and the housekeeping charge of 135.00 USD is taken as it stands.
